correctness.rationale: A chord of the ball is translated into z between -beta sqrt(1-|x|^2) and alpha sqrt(1-|x|^2), with alpha+beta=2. For the proposed E, upper inclusion has the exact nonnegative square remainder n*b*(b-beta)*(s-1/n)^2/alpha^2; lower branch quadratic is convex in s in the z<0 interval and its endpoint values are <=1; beta=0 reduces to flat base. The bottom pole and n regular-simplex upper-latitude contacts have normalized sum zero and weighted covariance I under John weights n/(n+1). This is a sufficient certificate for globally maximal volume and uniqueness. Expanding the axis radical gives lambda=0 exact endpoint, fixed lambda>0 limit 2lambda and fixed t crossover. Rechecked exact parameter identity, positive weights, upper/lower inclusion sampling and endpoint values separately for n=2,3,5,10,100 and lambda=0,0.1,0.25,0.49,0.5; finite samples only corroborate the analytic square/John proof.
